name: io.github.altipard/sevdesk-mcp
title: sevdesk (unofficial)
description: Unofficial sevdesk accounting tools: invoices, contacts, vouchers, banking. Read-only by default.

environmentVariables.name: SEVDESK_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: sevdesk API token (Settings > Users, 32 hex characters). Optional: without it the server reads the token from the system keychain (service sevdesk-mcp, account api-token), which `npx -y @altipard/sevdesk-mcp setup` fills.

environmentVariables.name: SEVDESK_MODE
environmentVariables.description: read (default): only reads. write: also drafts, contacts, payments and status changes; bookings and status changes need a confirmation.
